spec.model: pooled L2 LogisticRegression C=0.1, no interactions, no class_weight
spec.target: net_without_funding <= type-specific 20th percentile of Binance 2018-22 outcomes
spec.preprocessing: feature 1/99 pct clipping, median imputation, standardization: TRAIN ONLY
spec.split: train Binance entry<2023-01-01 and exit<2023-01-01; test Binance entry>=2023-01-01
spec.entry_policy: skip score >= type-specific train-score q80, frozen once
spec.external: Bitstamp 2014-17 backcast: descriptive transport check, not forward validation
spec.flow: spot flow24h and price-vs-CVD72h in case descriptors only; no flow model fitted

limits: All results are retrospective research on already inspected history, not independent forward confirmation.
Outcome excludes funding; entry/path/add/exit simulator defects remain in source snapshot.
Static removal preserves old trade sequence and is NOT a replay of a changed trading automaton.
Legacy MFE/MAE path flags are provisional, never features.
Monthly active-entry-cluster intervals are exploratory, not stationary equity block-bootstrap or selection-adjusted inference.
Bitstamp is backward transport, not a second prospective test.
